two_independent_axes.rule: Never overwrite original solver/preparation status, turn failure into success or infer Safety permission. Span completion means the measured block returned, not feasible or accepted.

cases.required: Close exact executed spans and return identical numerical tuple. Join actual legacy authority/application observations only after run; no approval from prepared status.

Close crossed spans as exception/partial in finally-safe hooks. Preserve original catch classes, diagnostics and re-raise if originally uncaught. Root may complete with returned None even if child failed.
Backend child exception or completed rejection, original adapter result/status unchanged; controller validation/reset recorded as executed. Missing later spans not_reached.
Existing shape/finite/constraint/bounds rejection remains. No extra evaluation, tolerance change, repaired solution or warm reset alteration.
Mark failed reached child; original planner produces same no-packet result or exception. No solve-only success relabel; final packet metadata untouched.
Preparation may be complete; readiness, waiting, acceptance/rejection and expiry remain distinct original outcomes. No timing-based insertion or grant.
If host prepare returned fully, charge full CPU in launch cohort and retain physical completion as censored. If host call itself was interrupted, retain partial lower bound and incomplete aggregate.
Latch invalid observer; preserve actual raw sequence, endpoints and unknowns. Never invent parent, auto-close as successful, flatten tree or replace missing duration by zero.

Raw noninteger/decreasing/raising clock read invalidates observer. Preserve available pair halves with reasons. Negative exclusive residual retained; reconciliation allowance remains a reviewed null prerequisite, not a clamp.

Reserved begun slots may still close. Latch first fault in reserved emergency status; do not append/drop/overwrite more records. Complete active original numerical work then stop before a new simulation event or preparation.
After measurement, preserve original raw result first; retain .partial output and error manifest if possible. No complete export claim, silent truncation, overwrite or rerun.

No infallibility claim. Preserve active original exception and best-effort already reserved evidence without arbitrary formatting; parent retains exit status/log and marks missing tail. Do not fabricate a complete numerical return or physical termination state.

observer_error_containment: Ordinary recorder/clock errors return fault status and must not reach existing numerical ValueError/RuntimeError handlers. Reporting failures are separate from original exceptions. Catastrophic failure can prevent persistence and is explicitly incomplete; no guarantee of zero-cost or exception-free observation.
safe_stop_points: Startup: after original prepare returns, before accepting/prepositioning startup authority; preserve original tuple separately and report observer-invalid launch rather than startup solver failure.

Recurring: original release setup/prepare returns normally; check sticky observer fault at the existing end-of-release reporting boundary before another completion/application/physics event. Preserve completed original call and already queued legacy metadata; terminate with existing stop_reason field instrumentation_stop, no fallback or new command.

Escaping original numerical exception: close observer best-effort and propagate the original type/traceback; if AsyncRunner never returns raw output, mark raw_not_returned and coverage unknown instead of inventing a partial raw result.
Post-run export: original result stays intact; observer/export validity and worker nonzero exit report are separate.

worker_exit_proposal.0: expected fixture numerical outcome plus valid observer/export
worker_exit_proposal.2: unsupported mode/invalid configuration before backend import
worker_exit_proposal.interrupt: retain actual process/interrupt status; no fabricated success

authority: No zero command, emergency brake, cancellation, permission epoch or Safety S1 grant is created by any observer state.
evidence: Unique fresh worker directories; never discard outliers, replace unsuccessful attempts, alter original historical exports or repair chronology to proceed.
